gates.reason: R06 executes 20 checks through actual NodiaAI/preview/Finance components, Axios HTTP, Nest and disposable PostgreSQL. Auth transport/Redis are declared synthetic; no provider, configured database or cloud storage is used. R02 confirms owned API/database cleanup. The native Claim/Execute use cases run through a closed test bridge; no standalone worker-process lifecycle is verified.

gates.reason: Actual HTTP enforces unrelated-user denial, omniscient inspection without confirming another owner intention, destination-module revocation/redaction and restoration. Editing creates a new exact preview revision; the human button confirms that revision and a wrong hash is denied before effects. Authentication transport is synthetic.

gates.reason: After native ClaimNodiaAiExecutionUseCase and ExecuteNodiaAiLocalExecutionUseCase run through the closed test bridge while UI observation is absent, returning restores the immutable receipt and persisted message without replay; the actual Finance page lists the expense. Cancellation keeps one effect and no second effect. This does not verify a standalone worker process.

These layers do not prove the full admitted-old-release to newly published product next-turn flow or hot reload.
